style.grade_suffix: Desaturated documentary outdoor photograph, overcast flat light or blue hour, muted greys and deep forest greens, cool charcoal shadows, low-key exposure, matte finish, fine 35mm film grain, natural textures (wet rock, packed dirt, forest duff, granite, gravel). No faces, no logos, no readable text, no orange props, no studio backdrop, no glossy product render.
style.negative: brand logos, readable text, watermark, saturated colour, sunset glow, cream or white seamless background, extra or bent tent poles, impossible tent geometry, warped hands, extra fingers, toy-like gear, festival tents, smiling stock models, HDR halos, orange accents
style.post_grade: run scripts/grade-images.mjs on every file (see IMAGE-LAYOUT-MAP.md section 2)
style.outputs: AVIF + WebP at 480/800/1200/1600w + JPG fallback; hero <=120KB, card <=45KB at 800w
